reference: The children awake at seven in the morning.
sk: Deti sa zobudia o siedmej ráno.
cz: Děti se probudí v sedm hodin ráno.
acceptable: The {children|kids} {wake up|wake|awake|will wake up} at seven {o'clock |}in the morning.
The {children|kids} {wake up|wake|awake|will wake up} at seven am.
At seven {o'clock |}in the morning, the {children|kids} {wake up|will wake up}.

mistakes.text: The children wake up {in|on} seven in the morning.
The children wake up at seven in morning.
The children wake up at seven at the morning.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Ráno je „in the morning“, nie „at the morning“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Ráno je „in the morning“, ne „at the morning“.

mistakes.text: The children wakes up at seven in the morning.
The childrens wake up at seven in the morning.

source_issues: EN verb 'awake' is literary; natural 'wake up' accepted. SK/CZ perfective 'zobudia/probudí' allows 'will wake up'.
